text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Eighth anniversary of Arab Maghreb Union (AMU).
- Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali says there is a need to push AMU forward despite difficulties.
- Final talks on regionalisation draft law.
- Staff at state-owned farmers' credit bank (CNCA) to stage second strike in less than a month to press for pay increases and other benefits.
- Morocco's tomato finds it difficult to find markets because of European Union constraints.
